Chapter 323 Running away as a drill (page 1)
An exercise run! (Running away like an exercise! (Page 22)) When Yan Yixie said that he wanted to drink the herbal tea, Xu Zhengsheng on the side immediately responded, got out of the car and went straight to the tea shed, ignoring the existence of these evil people. Pointing to the mansion, Yan Yixie said: "My husband is the owner of this place now, so it is better to get used to it first. Now the nine major sects have joined forces with the world's martial arts to investigate your whereabouts, especially around Shaolin, the interrogation is more rigorous, so It was a good time to take advantage of the opportunity to recuperate and avoid the limelight. Chen Feng was not as anxious as he was. Instead, he practiced swordsmanship every day. He had only mastered 30% to 40% of the swordsmanship taught to him by Qingfeng Sword Master. Cold weapons were not attractive to Yang Jian. He had the captain's light and the sky blood, but this time he came out to practice, and Zitong did not allow him to bring a cheating weapon like the sky blood. "Go away or not?" Li Qi's eyes were cold. Lie's expression became more intense, and the sword in his hand seemed to be able to come out of the body at any time. "Chen Feng is seriously injured, why are you so anxious to see him?" Qian Si Longyao, who was beside Chen Feng, suddenly asked. Since Mengdu said there is no danger, let's believe them for the time being. Since they are all here, it is impossible to say that they are not curious. However, now the opportunity has appeared in front of them. They have been practicing hard for decades. , practitioners who have been cultivating for hundreds of years have fallen into shackles after reaching a certain level. If there is no unexpected chance, they may not be able to make any progress in their lifetime. He slapped Xia Zhilong on the face again, and saw that the complicated look in his eyes disappeared, and then nodded seriously to Xia Mingfeng. Shen Shuiji looked at Zhong Jin with a smile on his face, but he was full of resentment in his heart.
